description: This file contains a report script for generating accounting entries in ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, validation, and formatting of accounting data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates presence of mandatory filters: company and fiscal year.

methods.name: set_account_currency
methods.description: Sets the company's default currency in filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Retrieves and processes accounting entries based on filters.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Fetches general ledger entries from the database with optional grouping.

methods.name: get_result_as_list
methods.description: Formats raw data into report rows, including currency and account details.
